title: Sensitivity at a satisfying DNF input
statement: Let $d$ be a DNF formula on $n$ Boolean variables and let $x\in\{0,1\}^n$ satisfy $d(x)=1$. The number of coordinates whose individual flip changes the sign encoding of the formula's value is at most the maximum width of a term of $d$, taken to be $0$ if $d$ has no terms.
hypotheses_covered: $d$ is a DNF formula on $n$ Boolean variables
replaced: Let $d$ be a DNF on $n$ variables and let $x\in\{0,1\}^n$ satisfy $d(x)=1$. The number of coordinates whose individual flip changes the sign encoding $(-1)^{d(x)}$ is at most the width of $d$.
